7.8 Error Classification
Chapter [4, General Specification of Basic Software Modules] 7.2 “Error Handling” describes the error handling of the Basic Software in detail. Above all, it constitutes a classification scheme consisting of five error types which may occur in BSW modules. Based on this foundation, the following section specifies particular errors arranged in the respective subsections below.
